## `SetProjectAnalyst`

*Available in [R](#setprojectanalyst-r)*
=== "R"
    !!! bug "Deprecated Function"
        This function has been deprecated, and will be removed in a future CIDAtools release.
    <h4>Description</h4>

    This function allows you to set the  project analyst.
    This will overwrite the current value if exists.

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    SetProjectAnalyst(analyst_name)

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `analyst_name` - A string containing the analyst name

    <h4>Returns</h4>

    A message stating the name has been changed.
